name: Koukio's Magic
source:
You or either a male John or a female Koki and either way your sister is Koukio, most of your memory is lost and Koukio tries to help you remember your mother, father, all that stuff, by taking you to places.

[From [url=https://facelesscat.itch.io/koukios-magic] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你可以扮演男性约翰或女性小希，无论选择哪一方，你的姐姐都是库基欧。你失去了大部分记忆，库基欧带你前往各处，试图帮助你想起母亲、父亲以及其他一切。

[来源：[url=https://facelesscat.itch.io/koukios-magic]itch.io[/url]]
